title: Canonical localization normalization of ordinary tensor representatives
statement: Let l be prime and Y any scheme. In the native module category A of [def-sf-native-weil-closed-models], use the canonical derived monoidal structure on D(A). There exist a symmetric structure beta, isomorphisms model(P,Q): Q(Q) tensor Q(P) ≅ Q(ordinaryTensorTotal(P,Q)) whenever P is NativeOrdinaryKFlat, and complex isomorphisms swap(P,Q): ordinaryTensorTotal(P,Q) ≅ ordinaryTensorTotal(Q,P) for all P,Q. The model is natural on complex maps f:P→P' and g:Q→Q' whenever P and P' are K-flat. The swap satisfies NativeOrdinarySignedSwap, and for K-flat P,Q, beta(Q(Q),Q(P)) followed by model(Q,P) equals model(P,Q) followed by Q(swap(P,Q)). This statement mentions no internal Hom or adjunction. Moreover the same chosen model admits complex isomorphisms kappa(P,Q): ordinaryTensorTotal(P,Q) ≅ Q tensor P. On each (p,q) summand, after precomposing with the balanced quotient tensorPi, kappa is (-1)^(pq) times the canonical inclusion of Q^q tensor P^p in the standard total Q tensor P. For K-flat P,Q the chosen model map is, as a heterogeneous equality, exactly the canonical lax localization tensorator mu(qQ,qP) followed by q(kappa(P,Q) inverse). The canonical monoidal structure and its tensorator are those of [lem-sf-ringed-derived-native-tensor]. No arbitrary adjunction normalization is used to infer associator coherence.

proof.text: Reuse the explicit ordinaryTotalIso, ordinaryModel and ordinarySwap constructed in the proof of [lem-sf-native-ordinary-tensor-representatives], together with their proved naturality, signed swap and braiding equations. This selects the actual constructed witnesses, not an arbitrary witness of the existential statement.

Precompose ordinaryTotalIso_ι with the balanced quotient tensorPi. The equation NativeAux.tensorComponent_π identifies the underived tensor comparison with the canonical quotient tensorObjPi. Pull the integer sign through composition. This gives the displayed summand formula.

The hom of ordinaryModel is definitionally the lax localization tensorator followed by Q.map of ordinaryTotalIso inverse. Thus the required heterogeneous equality holds by reflexivity, in particular on pairs of K-flat inputs.

lean.statement:
theorem native_ordinary_canonical_tensor_representatives (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Y : Scheme.{u}) :
    ∃ β : SymmetricCategory (DerivedCategory (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y)),
    ∃ model : ∀ P Q : CochainComplex (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y) ℤ,
      NativeOrdinaryKFlat l Y P →
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q ⊗ DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅
          DerivedCategory.Q.obj (ordinaryTensorTotal l Y P Q)),
    ∃ swap : ∀ P Q : CochainComplex (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y) ℤ,
      ordinaryTensorTotal l Y P Q ≅ ordinaryTensorTotal l Y Q P,
      (∀ (P Q P' Q' : CochainComplex (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y) ℤ)
        (hP : NativeOrdinaryKFlat l Y P) (hP' : NativeOrdinaryKFlat l Y P')
        (f : P ⟶ P') (g : Q ⟶ Q'),
        (DerivedCategory.Q.map g ⊗ₘ DerivedCategory.Q.map f) ≫ (model P' Q' hP').hom =
          (model P Q hP).hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map
            (HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorMap f g (ordinaryTensorBifunctor l Y) (.up ℤ))) ∧
      NativeOrdinarySignedSwap l Y swap ∧
      (∀ (P Q : CochainComplex (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y) ℤ)
        (hP : NativeOrdinaryKFlat l Y P) (hQ : NativeOrdinaryKFlat l Y Q),
        (β.toBraidedCategory.braiding (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q)
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)).hom ≫ (model Q P hQ).hom =
          (model P Q hP).hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map (swap P Q).hom) ∧
    (∃ κ : ∀ P Q : CochainComplex (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y) ℤ,
        ordinaryTensorTotal l Y P Q ≅ Q ⊗ P,
      (∀ (P Q : CochainComplex (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y) ℤ)
        (p q n : ℤ) (hpq : p + q = n) (hqp : q + p = n),
        Mod.tensorπ (Q.X q) (P.X p) ≫
            (HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor P Q (ordinaryTensorBifunctor l Y)
              (.up ℤ) p q n hpq).hom ≫ ((κ P Q).hom.f n).hom =
          (p * q).negOnePow •
            (Mod.tensorObjπ (Q.X q) (P.X p) ≫
              (HomologicalComplex.ιTensorObj Q P q p n hqp).hom)) ∧
      ∀ (P Q : CochainComplex (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y) ℤ)
        (hP : NativeOrdinaryKFlat l Y P) (_hQ : NativeOrdinaryKFlat l Y Q),
        HEq (model P Q hP).hom
          (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ DerivedCategory.Q Q P ≫
            DerivedCategory.Q.map (κ P Q).inv))
